limitations: Review labels describe target geometry, not independently surveyed semantic classes or envelope membership.
Unresolved events are included without exclusion.
Association residuals are recorded after mount reseed and use physical coordinates, not fitted lateral offsets.
The broad geometry families do not establish that a safe automatic rejection rule exists.
